title: Daegu City Tour Bus 2026: City Circle Route, Timetable, Prices and 20% Foreigner Discount
description: Daegu City Tour guide, checked October 2026: the 12-stop City Circle course from Dongdaegu Station (Seomun Market, E-World, Apsan, Suseong Lake), hourly timetable, KRW 10,000 fare, 20% discount for foreign visitors and how to pay on board.
h1Sub: City Circle route, timetable and prices
lead: The Daegu City Tour is a hop-on hop-off loop from Dongdaegu Station past Kim Kwang-seok Street, Dongseong-ro, the Modern Culture Alley, Seomun Market, E-World, Apsan, Suseong Lake and the Daegu Art Museum. Buy your ticket from the driver and ride all day. Foreign visitors get 20% off.
summary: City Circle course · 12 stops · about 2 h 20 min per loop
Tuesday to Sunday · 09:30–15:30 from Dongdaegu Station · hourly, 7 runs (closed Mondays and Lunar New Year and Chuseok days)
KRW 10,000 adult · KRW 8,000 youth · KRW 6,000 senior, child, disabled
20% for foreigners, same-day train, express bus or flight ticket holders and hotel guests · 30% every Wednesday
Buy from the driver on board (cash, card or transport card)

routes.name: City Circle course
routes.area: Dongseong-ro · Seomun Market · Apsan · Suseong Lake
stops: Daegu Art Museum / Daegu Kansong Art Museum
routes.tip: Buses come once an hour, so check the next time before you get off. Apsan Observatory is reached by cable car from the Apsan Park stop (fare extra).

tickets.name: City Circle day ticket
tickets.price: KRW 10,000 adult · KRW 8,000 youth · KRW 6,000 senior and child

tickets.name: Discount fare
tickets.price: KRW 8,000 adult · KRW 6,400 youth · KRW 4,800 senior and child
includes: Foreigners; same-day train, express bus or flight ticket holders; hotel guests; groups of 10+

priceNote: Fares from the official Daegu City Tour site on 29 October 2026. Show your passport or ticket when you pay to get the discount. One infant under 48 months rides free per adult; admission fees are extra.
howToBook: No booking needed: pay the driver on board by cash, card or transport card.
Show your passport for the 20% foreigner discount; every Wednesday there is a 30% discount event.
Seats are first come, first served and standing is not allowed; if the bus is full, take the next one an hour later.
howToRide: Board at the stop in front of Dongdaegu Station plaza, or at any other stop.
Pay as you board and keep your ticket; a lost ticket cannot be replaced.
Get off anywhere and catch the next bus an hour later.
The last bus leaves Dongdaegu Station at 15:30 and returns around 17:50.

faq.q: Does the Daegu City Tour run every day?
faq.a: Tuesday to Sunday. It is closed every Monday and on Lunar New Year and Chuseok days.

faq.q: How much is the Daegu City Tour?
faq.a: KRW 10,000 for adults, or KRW 8,000 with the 20% discount for foreign visitors.
No. Buy your ticket from the driver when you board.
At Dongdaegu Station, where KTX and SRT trains arrive; you can also board at any other stop.
